get.summary: Lists the caller's sessions with their catalog fields.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client key that makes a prompt submission idempotent within its session. A repeat with the same key and the same prompt returns the original 202 response; the same key with a different prompt returns 409. A key still in progress returns 409. Keys are 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters.

get.summary: Builds the Kanban board from the caller's sessions.
Reads what the substrate knows about the session behind a card.

post.summary: Closes a session: stops its live run and moves it to the archived column.
Settles the orphaned run of a lost session so it accepts a new prompt.

get.summary: Reads the workspace name, its folder name and the plugin check for the top bar.
Streams catalog, session status and stage events of the caller's sessions. The stream does not end at a terminal session event.
Reads the latest event of every stage of the session.
Reads the task context of the session: task, Graph, workflow phase, shared memory and lessons.

post.summary: Sends a message to the active turn, now or as a queued follow-up, and reports how it was delivered.

get.summary: Lists the tool approvals that wait for a decision.
Reads the model, mode and thinking options the engine reports for the session.

put.summary: Changes one option of a session whose run holds a live engine session.

get.summary: Lists the slash commands the engine advertises for the session.
Lists the files the session's runs edited, with their before and after text and review state.

post.summary: Accepts the change of one file. The path is URL-encoded.
Rejects the change of one file and restores its text before the edit. The path is URL-encoded.

get.summary: Names the licence and the source repository of this running service (AGPL-3.0-or-later section 13).
Lists the commands, skills, rules, subagents, hooks files and MCP files of the server workspace, with precedence and diagnostics.
Reads the effective limits and options of the API as read-only values.
Reads the plugin connection check and the plugin inventory of the API.
Lists the upstreams the API is configured for. The API sends no request, so nothing is checked.
Reads the effective hooks, the files they came from, the loading problems and the consent state. No hook is started.
Reads the automations of the host, or reports that none is configured. No run is started.

post.summary: Creates an automation: a prompt, triggers (cron, webhook) and a target. A webhook secret is generated and shown once in the answer.

get.summary: Lists one folder of the server workspace. Secret files and links that leave the workspace are not listed.
Reads one UTF-8 text file of the server workspace, up to 1 MiB. Binary and secret files are refused.
Lists the provider catalogue, filtered by region, kind and search text, with whether the service has a key for each provider. No key is ever returned.
Reads one catalogue provider with whether the service has a key for it.

put.summary: Hands an API key to omp. Write-only; disabled unless the operator sets Providers:AllowCredentialWrite.
Makes a model the default for new chats. Disabled unless the operator sets Providers:AllowConfigWrite.

post.summary: Adds an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint to omp. https is required except on this machine; link-local and metadata addresses and user information are refused. Disabled unless the operator sets Providers:AllowConfigWrite.

delete.summary: Removes a custom endpoint the caller added. Disabled unless the operator sets Providers:AllowConfigWrite.

post.summary: Asks whether something answers at the provider's address. Sends no key; skipped unless the operator sets Providers:AllowLiveTest.
Creates a cloud agent bound to repositories, a branch and secret references, and starts provisioning its worker.

get.summary: Lists the caller's cloud agents, newest first.
Reads one cloud agent.

delete.summary: Deletes a cloud agent and removes its worker and volume. The session log stays.

post.summary: Sends a prompt to a cloud agent. The run executes on the agent's worker; its events stream from /cloud/agents/{id}/events.
Cancels the run in flight on this server instance.
Stops a cloud agent: cancels its run and lets its worker sleep. A wake request starts it again.
Wakes an idle, stopped, failed or orphaned cloud agent. The worker comes up in the background; poll the agent until it is running.

get.summary: Streams the agent's events: the same kinds, ids and resume rules as GET /sessions/{id}/events.

post.summary: Opens a pull request from the agent's branch. It is ready for review unless a draft is requested and allowed.

get.summary: Lists the caller's secrets by name. Values are never returned.
Tells whether a secret exists and when it was written. The value is write-only.

put.summary: Stores or replaces a secret. It reaches an agent's environment only at provisioning and is redacted from output.

delete.summary: Deletes a secret. Agents that were already provisioned keep the value in their environment until they are deleted.

get.summary: Reports the caller's caps and how much of them is used.
Lists the caller's automations with their next run and last run, newest first.
Shows the next occurrences of a cron expression in a time zone.
Reads one automation.

put.summary: Replaces an automation's definition. The webhook secret is kept; one is generated when the first webhook trigger is added.

delete.summary: Deletes an automation with its history and its webhook secret.

put.summary: Turns an automation's triggers on or off. A run by hand stays possible while it is off.

post.summary: Replaces the webhook secret. The new secret is shown once; the old one stops working at once.
Runs an automation now, whether or not it is enabled. The run continues in the background.

get.summary: Reads an automation's run history, newest first.

post.summary: The webhook receiver. Anonymous, authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 signature; every authentication failure answers the same 401.

nextRuns.description: Gets the next occurrences, in UTC, soonest first. Empty when the expression is invalid or never fires.

error.description: Gets why the expression or the time zone is invalid, or null when both are valid.

AutomationCronPreviewResponse.description: The body of `GET /automations/cron-preview`: the next occurrences of a cron expression.

prompt.description: Gets the instructions each run starts with.

enabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether triggers start runs.

allowedTools.description: Gets the tools a run may use.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Gets how many runs may be active at once.

maxRunsPerHour.description: Gets how many runs may start in any rolling hour.

timeZone.description: Gets the time zone cron triggers are evaluated in.

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Gets the longest a run may last, in minutes.

createdAt.description: Gets when the automation was created.

updatedAt.description: Gets when the automation was last changed.

nextRunAt.description: Gets when the next cron trigger fires, or null when the automation is off, has no cron trigger or none fires.

oneOf.description: Gets the most recent run, or null when it has none.

webhookPath.description: Gets the path of the webhook receiver, `/hooks/automations/{id}`, or null when the automation has no webhook trigger. Prefix it with the API origin.

hasWebhookSecret.description: Gets a value indicating whether a webhook secret is stored. The value is shown once, when it is created or rotated.

AutomationInfo.description: An automation as the API reports it. It never carries the webhook secret.

outcome.description: Gets how the attempt ended: `succeeded`, `failed`, `timed-out`, `cancelled`, `blocked` or `refused`.

reason.description: Gets a human-readable reason, or an empty string.

recordedAt.description: Gets when the attempt was recorded.

AutomationLastRunInfo.description: The latest run attempt of an automation.

AutomationListResponse.description: The body of `GET /automations/definitions`: the caller's automations, newest first.

guard.description: Gets the name of the guard that paused the automation.

reason.description: Gets why the guard paused it.

howToResume.description: Gets what an operator does to resume the automation.

AutomationPauseInfo.description: The pause a guard placed on an automation.

address.description: Gets the HTTPS clone URL, for example `https://github.com/owner/repo`. No credentials, query or fragment.

branch.description: Gets the branch the agent starts from. When absent the repository's default branch is used.

baseBranch.description: Gets the branch a pull request targets. When absent it is the branch the agent started from.

AutomationRepositoryInfo.description: A repository a cloud automation works in.

trigger.description: Gets what started the run: `manual`, `cron` or `webhook`.

summary.description: Gets one line that says what happened, for example `push to main by octocat (3 commits)`. Taken from outside OmpOS for webhook runs: show it as text.

status.description: Gets how the run stands or ended: `running`, `succeeded`, `launched`, `failed`, `timed_out`, `cancelled` or `skipped`.

finishedAt.description: Gets when the run ended, or null while it runs.

durationSeconds.description: Gets how long the run lasted, in seconds, or null while it runs.

error.description: Gets why a run failed, timed out or was skipped. Never holds a secret.

externalId.description: Gets the identifier of what the run created, for example the cloud agent (see `GET /cloud/agents/{id}`).

AutomationRunListResponse.description: The body of `GET /automations/{id}/runs`: the run history, newest first, at most 100.

automation.description: Gets the automation after the change.

webhookSecret.description: Gets the webhook signing secret that this call generated, shown this once. Absent when the call generated none.

AutomationSaveResponse.description: The answer of a create, replace or secret rotation. It is the only place a webhook secret ever appears.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether this API has an automation engine configured.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why automations are unavailable, or null.

automations.description: Gets the automations; empty when unavailable.

AutomationsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /automations`: the automations the host configured. The API starts no run.

kind.description: Gets the kind of target: `cloud` (a cloud agent) or `local` (a desktop session; the API host has none). Default `cloud`.

repositories.description: Gets the repositories a cloud agent works in, 1 to 16 for a cloud target.

secretRefs.description: Gets the names of the cloud secrets (see `PUT /cloud/secrets/{name}`) to load into the agent. Names only, never values.

environmentId.description: Gets the name of a saved cloud environment definition.

model.description: Gets the model hint passed to the agent.

mode.description: Gets the engine mode hint passed to the agent.

AutomationTargetInfo.description: Where an automation runs and what the run starts with. Secrets are named, never carried.

kind.description: Gets the kind of trigger: `cron` or `webhook`.

cron.description: Gets the five-field cron expression of a cron trigger, for example `0 9 * * mon-fri`.

flavour.description: Gets the sender a webhook trigger accepts: `generic` (default) or `github`.

events.description: Gets the GitHub events a webhook accepts: `push`, `pull_request`. Empty accepts both.

actions.description: Gets the pull request actions a GitHub webhook accepts, for example `opened`, `synchronize`, `merged`. Empty accepts every action.

branches.description: Gets the branch globs a GitHub webhook accepts (the pushed branch or the pull request's base branch). Empty accepts every branch.

AutomationTriggerInfo.description: One trigger of an automation. The automation runs when any of its triggers fires.

status.description: Gets what the receiver did: `accepted` (a run started), `ignored` (authentic, but no trigger wants it or the automation is off), `pong` (a GitHub ping).

runId.description: Gets the identifier of the run that started, for `accepted`.

AutomationWebhookResponse.description: The body of the webhook receiver's success answers.

title.description: Gets the card title. It is derived from the session identifier, never from a prompt.

rowStatus.description: Gets the status the rail shows for the session.

columnKey.description: Gets the key of the column the card sits in.

lastActivityAt.description: Gets the time of the last activity of the session.

isStale.description: Gets a value indicating whether the session shows as running but has had no activity for longer than a run lease lives.

closed.description: Gets a value indicating whether the operator closed the session.

BoardCard.description: One task card of the board: one session.

key.description: Gets the stable column key: `backlog`, `queued`, `running`, `awaiting-input`, `needs-attention`, `paused`, `completed`, `failed`, `unreachable` or `archived`.

acceptsDrop.description: Gets a value indicating whether a dragged card may be dropped here: true only for Backlog and Archived.

cards.description: Gets the cards of the column, most recent activity first.

columns.description: Gets the columns in display order. Every column is present, empty ones with no cards.

BoardResponse.description: The answer of `GET /board`: the columns and cards built from the catalog.

BoardStateKind.description: The state of the whole board. The server answers BoardStateKind.Empty or BoardStateKind.Ready; BoardStateKind.Loading and BoardStateKind.Error exist so a client models all four states of the desktop board with one type.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether a task-context source answered. When false every other field is null and string? CardDetailsResponse.Reason says why.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the details are unavailable, or null when they are available.

taskTitle.description: Gets the title of the task the session works on, or null when not reported.

graphId.description: Gets the Graph identifier of the session's plan, or null when not reported.

lessonsCount.description: Gets the number of lessons recorded for the task, or null when not reported.

leaseHolder.description: Gets the holder of the task lease, or null when the source did not report one.

CardDetailsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /sessions/{id}/card-details`: what the substrate knows about the session behind a card.

CatalogRowGroup.description: The rail group of a catalog row, in display order. The members and their order mirror the desktop rail groups.

CatalogRowStatus.description: The status a catalog row shows. It combines the stored session status, the closed flag and the staleness of a running session; the members mirror the desktop row statuses.

CatalogSessionKind.description: What a catalog row is. The wire value is the lower-case member name.

path.description: Gets the path of the change, as `GET /sessions/{id}/changes` reports it.

status.description: Gets the review state after the decision.

applied.description: Gets a value indicating whether the decision wrote the file in the workspace. False when the decision was only recorded.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why nothing was written, or null when the decision was applied.

ChangeKind.description: Whether a change created a file or edited one.

ChangeReviewStatus.description: The review state of a change.

code.description: Gets the stable machine-readable code, for example `wake_timeout`.

CloudAgentError.description: Why a cloud agent is in CloudAgentStatus.Failed or CloudAgentStatus.Orphaned. The message never carries a secret value.

CloudAgentListResponse.description: The body of `GET /cloud/agents`: the caller's agents, newest first.

createdAt.description: Gets when the agent was created.

repositories.description: Gets the repositories the agent works in.

workerRef.description: Gets an opaque reference to the worker, or null while none exists. It is not a provider identifier and cannot be used to reach the worker.

branch.description: Gets the branch the agent pushes to in every repository.

sessionId.description: Gets the identifier of the session that holds the agent's event log: `GET /sessions/{sessionId}` reads it, and `GET /cloud/agents/{id}/events` streams it.

pullRequests.description: Gets the pull requests the agent opened. Empty until one is.

oneOf.description: Gets the most recent pull request, or null. It mirrors the Cursor API's single `pullRequest` member.

lastActivityAt.description: Gets when the agent last started or finished a run, or was created.

idleAt.description: Gets when the agent went idle, or null while it is not idle.

idleMinutes.description: Gets the minutes without activity after which the agent goes idle.

computeSeconds.description: Gets the seconds the worker was awake for this agent, including the current stretch.

secretRefs.description: Gets the names of the secrets loaded into the agent. Never values.

model.description: Gets the model hint, or null.

mode.description: Gets the mode hint, or null.

oneOf.description: Gets why the agent failed or is orphaned, or null.

CloudAgentResponse.description: One cloud agent as the API shows it. No field holds a secret, a token or a provider identifier.

CloudAgentStatus.description: Where a cloud agent is in its life. The wire value is the lower-case member name, with an underscore in CloudAgentStatus.LimitReached.

maxAgents.description: Gets how many agents the caller may own.

maxConcurrentRunning.description: Gets how many agents may be provisioning, starting or running at once.

agents.description: Gets how many agents the caller owns now.

running.description: Gets how many of them are provisioning, starting or running now.

defaultIdleMinutes.description: Gets the idle window applied when a request names none, in minutes.

maxComputeSecondsPerAgent.description: Gets the compute seconds one agent may use, or 0 for no limit.

computeSeconds.description: Gets the compute seconds all the caller's agents used so far.

CloudLimitsResponse.description: The body of `GET /cloud/limits`: the caller's caps and what they use of them.

sessionId.description: Gets the session whose log receives the run's events.

status.description: Gets the status the agent had when the prompt was accepted.

prompt.description: Gets the prompt text. Required, not blank, within the configured prompt length.

repository.description: Gets the clone URL of the repository the pull request is in.

url.description: Gets the web URL of the pull request.

branch.description: Gets the branch the agent pushed (always `ompos/cloud/<agent id>`).

baseBranch.description: Gets the branch the pull request targets.

draft.description: Gets whether the pull request was opened as a draft.

createdAt.description: Gets when the control plane opened it.

CloudPullRequest.description: A pull request a cloud agent opened.

url.description: Gets the HTTPS clone URL, for example `https://github.com/owner/repo`. No credentials, query or fragment.

branch.description: Gets the branch the agent starts from. When absent the repository's default branch is used.

baseBranch.description: Gets the branch a pull request targets. When absent it is the branch the agent started from.

CloudRepository.description: One repository a cloud agent works in.

name.description: Gets the secret name, which is also the name of the environment variable it becomes in the worker.

updatedAt.description: Gets when the secret was last written.

CloudSecretInfo.description: What the API tells about a stored secret: that it exists and when it was last written, never its value or its length.

secrets.description: Gets the secrets, ordered by name.

CloudSecretListResponse.description: The body of `GET /cloud/secrets`: the caller's secrets by name.

value.description: Gets the secret value, 4 to 8 192 characters. Values shorter than 4 characters cannot be redacted reliably and are refused.

CloudSecretValueRequest.description: The body of `PUT /cloud/secrets/{name}`. The value is write-only: no endpoint returns it.

id.description: Gets the engine's identifier of the option, for example `model`, `mode` or `thinking`. It names the option in `PUT /sessions/{id}/config-options/{optionId}`.

name.description: Gets the display name, or null.

category.description: Gets the category the engine gave the option (`model`, `mode` or `thought_level`), or null.

currentValue.description: Gets the value the option has now.

values.description: Gets the values the option can take, in the engine's order.

ConfigOption.description: One select-style option of a session that the engine owns: its model, its mode or its thinking level.

value.description: Gets the engine's identifier of the value. It is sent back verbatim to select it.

ConfigOptionValue.description: One value a ConfigOption can take.

id.description: Gets the identifier of the note in its origin.

text.description: Gets the note text. Consumers show it as text and never as markup.

origin.description: Gets the name of the place the note came from, for example the memory scope.

recordedAt.description: Gets the time the note was recorded, or null when the origin does not say.

ContextNote.description: One piece of shared context, a remembered fact or a lesson from earlier work. The text is untrusted, plain text.

description.description: Gets the description, which may be empty.

argumentHint.description: Gets the hint for the text typed after the name, or null.

sourceDirectory.description: Gets the convention directory that holds the file, for example `.cursor`, or an empty string for a file at the root itself.

directoryRank.description: Gets the position of string ConventionCommandInfo.SourceDirectory in the precedence order (`.ompos` 0, `.omp` 1, `.cursor` 2, `.claude` 3, `.codex` 4, `.agents` 5; lower wins), or null for a file at the root itself.

origin.description: Gets the path to show: relative to the workspace folder, or `~/` relative for a user file. It is never an absolute server path.

sourceDirectory.description: Gets the convention directory that holds the file, for example `.cursor`, or an empty string for a file at the root itself.

directoryRank.description: Gets the position of string ConventionConfigFileInfo.SourceDirectory in the precedence order (`.ompos` 0, `.omp` 1, `.cursor` 2, `.claude` 3, `.codex` 4, `.agents` 5; lower wins), or null for a file at the root itself.

origin.description: Gets the path to show: relative to the workspace folder, or `~/` relative for a user file. It is never an absolute server path.

ConventionDiagnosticCode.description: Why a convention file produced no item or lost to another item.

origin.description: Gets the path to show, relative to the workspace folder or `~/` relative.

reason.description: Gets one plain sentence that says why. It holds no absolute server path.

ConventionDiagnosticInfo.description: A problem found while discovering conventions.

ConventionItemType.description: The kind of convention file an item or a diagnostic belongs to.

name.description: Gets the rule name: its path under the `rules` folder without the extension, or the path of an instruction file.

type.description: Gets the form of the file.

description.description: Gets the description, which may be empty.

globs.description: Gets the globs the rule is tied to; empty when it is not tied to files.

alwaysApply.description: Gets a value indicating whether the rule always applies.

scopeDirectory.description: Gets the folder, relative to the workspace folder, that a nested rule applies to; empty for the root and for user rules.

sourceDirectory.description: Gets the convention directory that holds the file, for example `.cursor`, or an empty string for a file at the root itself.

directoryRank.description: Gets the position of string ConventionRuleInfo.SourceDirectory in the precedence order (`.ompos` 0, `.omp` 1, `.cursor` 2, `.claude` 3, `.codex` 4, `.agents` 5; lower wins), or null for a file at the root itself.

origin.description: Gets the path to show: relative to the workspace folder, or `~/` relative for a user file. It is never an absolute server path.

ConventionRuleType.description: The form of a rule file.

ConventionScopeKind.description: Where a discovered convention item lives.

description.description: Gets the description, which may be empty.

paths.description: Gets the globs that scope the skill; empty when it applies everywhere.

disableModelInvocation.description: Gets a value indicating whether the model may not pick the skill by itself.

userInvocable.description: Gets a value indicating whether the skill is offered after a slash.

scopeDirectory.description: Gets the folder, relative to the workspace folder, that a nested skill is scoped to; empty for the root and for user skills.

sourceDirectory.description: Gets the convention directory that holds the file, for example `.cursor`, or an empty string for a file at the root itself.

directoryRank.description: Gets the position of string ConventionSkillInfo.SourceDirectory in the precedence order (`.ompos` 0, `.omp` 1, `.cursor` 2, `.claude` 3, `.codex` 4, `.agents` 5; lower wins), or null for a file at the root itself.

origin.description: Gets the path to show: relative to the workspace folder, or `~/` relative for a user file. It is never an absolute server path.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether the API has a workspace folder it could read. When false, every list is empty and string? ConventionsResponse.Reason says why.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the conventions are unavailable, or null.

includesUserScope.description: Gets a value indicating whether the user directories of the API process home were read (`Api:Workspace:IncludeUserScope`).

commands.description: Gets the custom commands: project items then user items, each in name order.

rules.description: Gets the rules and instruction files.

hookFiles.description: Gets the `hooks.json` files, highest precedence first.

mcpFiles.description: Gets the `mcp.json` files, highest precedence first.

diagnostics.description: Gets every problem: malformed, oversize or unreadable files, refused symbolic links, and items that lost to a duplicate.

ConventionsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /workspace/conventions`: the commands, skills, rules, subagents, hooks files and MCP files of the server workspace, with the precedence winner of each name and every diagnostic.

description.description: Gets the description, which may be empty.

model.description: Gets the model the subagent asks for, or null.

readOnly.description: Gets a value indicating whether the subagent must not change files.

isBackground.description: Gets a value indicating whether the subagent runs in the background.

sourceDirectory.description: Gets the convention directory that holds the file, for example `.cursor`, or an empty string for a file at the root itself.

directoryRank.description: Gets the position of string ConventionSubagentInfo.SourceDirectory in the precedence order (`.ompos` 0, `.omp` 1, `.cursor` 2, `.claude` 3, `.codex` 4, `.agents` 5; lower wins), or null for a file at the root itself.

origin.description: Gets the path to show: relative to the workspace folder, or `~/` relative for a user file. It is never an absolute server path.

ConventionSubagentInfo.description: A subagent definition the workspace holds.

name.description: Gets the display name, 1 to 100 characters. When absent the agent is named after its first repository.

repositories.description: Gets the repositories the agent works in, 1 to 16. The first is the primary one: the agent starts there.

environmentId.description: Gets the name of a saved environment definition to use instead of the repository's own `environment.json`.

secretRefs.description: Gets the names of the secrets (see `PUT /cloud/secrets/{name}`) to load into the agent's environment. Names only, never values.

idleMinutes.description: Gets the minutes without activity after which the agent goes idle. When absent the server default (15) applies.

model.description: Gets the model the agent should use, passed to the engine as a hint. Optional.

mode.description: Gets the engine mode (for example `agent` or `plan`), passed as a hint. Optional.

repository.description: Gets the clone URL of the repository to open the pull request in. When absent the agent's primary repository is used.

title.description: Gets the pull request title. Required, 1 to 256 characters.

body.description: Gets the pull request description. Optional, up to 65 536 characters.

baseBranch.description: Gets the target branch. When absent the repository entry's base branch, its start branch, or the default branch is used, in that order.

draft.description: Gets whether to open a draft. When absent the pull request is ready for review. The server setting `Cloud:PullRequests:NeverDraft` overrides `true`.

ownerId.description: Gets a body owner identifier, which is refused with 400 when non-null.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Request body for `POST /sessions`. The owner is never taken from the body; it is the caller's subject.

providerId.description: Gets the provider the key was written for.

configured.description: Gets whether omp now holds a credential for the provider.

id.description: Gets the provider id as omp uses it in a model selector.

displayName.description: Gets the name shown for the endpoint.

baseUrl.description: Gets the base URL as the service wrote it to omp's configuration.

keyEnvName.description: Gets the name of the environment variable the operator sets to the key, or null when the endpoint needs no key.

configured.description: Gets whether the service sees that variable set.

CustomProviderProtocol.description: The wire protocol of a custom endpoint.

displayName.description: Gets the name shown for the endpoint, at most 80 characters. Defaults to the id.

modelIds.description: Gets the model ids, at least one and at most 50.

keyRequired.description: Gets a value indicating whether the endpoint needs a key. Defaults to true; the key itself is never part of this request.

CustomProviderRequest.description:

number.description: Gets the phase number as written in the roadmap, for example `25.6`.

status.description: Gets the phase status as the planning files record it, for example `complete` or `in progress`.

plansComplete.description: Gets the number of completed plans in the phase.

plansTotal.description: Gets the total number of plans in the phase.

GsdPhaseInfo.description: The workflow phase a session works on, as the workflow engine's planning files record it.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether the API has a workspace folder whose hooks it could read.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the hooks are unavailable, or null.

consentRecorded.description: Gets a value indicating whether the API knows the recorded consent of each hook. It is false: consent is recorded by the head that runs the hook, so bool WorkspaceHookInfo.PreConsented is the only consent the API reports.

hooks.description: Gets every hook in merge order, including disabled hooks.

sources.description: Gets the files the hooks were read from, in merge order.

diagnostics.description: Gets the problems found while loading.

role.description: Gets the message role (for example "user" or "assistant").

timestamp.description: Gets the timestamp the message was recorded.

Message.description: A single chat message inside a session.

name.description: Gets what the upstream is for, for example `Sign-in authority`.

host.description: Gets the upstream as host or host:port. It never holds a scheme, a path, a query or credentials.

checked.description: Gets a value indicating whether any upstream was contacted. It is always false: the API sends nothing.

reason.description: Gets one plain sentence that says why the upstreams are not checked.

NetworkSettingsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /settings/network`: the upstreams the API is configured for. The API makes no outbound call to answer, so every entry is unchecked.

requestId.description: Gets the request identifier a decision is addressed to.

toolName.description: Gets the tool the request concerns.

requestedAt.description: Gets when the request was made.

grantableTools.description: Gets the tools a decision may allow. Empty means the policy ceiling permits none, so only a deny can be recorded.

PendingToolApproval.description: One tool approval that waits for a decision.

PendingToolApprovalsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /sessions/{id}/tool-approvals`: the requests that wait for a decision, oldest first.

summary.description: Gets a plain-text summary of the result. It never contains a path or a credential.

PluginCheckResult.description: The outcome of the workspace plugin check, in plain text.

PluginCheckStatus.description: The result of the workspace plugin check.

check.description: Gets the plugin check result. Its status is `unavailable` when the API has no plugin inventory.

plugins.description: Gets the plugins in composition order; empty when the API has no inventory.

PluginsSettingsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /settings/plugins`: the workspace plugin check and the plugin inventory the API has.

sessionId.description: Gets the session the prompt was accepted on.

intentKind.description: Gets the parser intent-kind name assigned to the prompt (for example `Steer` or `Fallback`).

diagnosticCodes.description: Gets the parser diagnostic codes recorded with the prompt.

prompt.description: Gets the prompt text. Required, non-empty, within the configured length limit.

ProviderConfiguredState.description: Whether the service already has what it needs to call a provider. It says a key is present, never that it works.

ProviderKind.description: What a catalogue provider sells or runs.

ruleText.description: Gets the vendor's rule for using the plan key.

ruleSourceUrl.description: Gets the page that states the rule, or null.

interactiveOnly.description: Gets a value indicating whether the vendor limits the key to interactive use in named tools.

separateKey.description: Gets a value indicating whether the plan has a key of its own.

planUrl.description: Gets the page of the plan.

listedTools.description: Gets the tools the vendor lists for the plan.

ProviderPlanInfo.description: The terms of a coding plan provider.

priceVerified.description: Gets a value indicating whether the research verified the price.

quotaText.description: Gets the published usage limits as text, or null when the vendor publishes none.

ProviderPlanTierInfo.description: One tier of a coding plan.

ProviderRegion.description: The part of the world a catalogue provider belongs to. It groups the list; it is not a residency claim.

id.description: Gets the route slug, unique inside its provider.

api.description: Gets the omp `api` value the route speaks, for example `openai-completions`.

baseUrlTemplate.description: Gets the base URL or URL template. A placeholder is written `{name}`.

auth.description: Gets how the key is sent, as words: `Bearer`, `x-api-key`, `header NAME` or `none`.

takesKey.description: Gets a value indicating whether the route takes a key.

discoversModels.description: Gets a value indicating whether omp may discover the models of the route.

needsUserModels.description: Gets a value indicating whether the user has to name a model id.

documentedModels.description: Gets the example models the vendor documents.

ProviderRouteInfo.description: One way to reach a catalogue provider.

providers.description: Gets the catalogue providers that match the filters, in catalogue order.

total.description: Gets how many providers the catalogue holds before the filters.

custom.description: Gets the custom endpoints the caller added.

ompInstalled.description: Gets a value indicating whether omp is installed on the service.

credentialWritesEnabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether the operator allows keys to be written through the API.

configWritesEnabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether the operator allows custom endpoints and the default model to be changed through the API.

liveTestsEnabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether the operator allows live tests.

defaultModel.description: Gets the default model as `provider/model`, or null when omp reports none or cannot be read.

ProvidersResponse.description: The answer of `GET /providers`: the catalogue rows that match the filters, the caller's custom endpoints and what the service allows.

id.description: Gets the provider slug, unique in the catalogue.

displayName.description: Gets the name shown on the card.

region.description: Gets the part of the world the provider belongs to.

country.description: Gets the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the vendor or host, or null.

residencyNote.description: Gets what the vendor states about where data is processed, or null. OmpOS does not verify it.

kind.description: Gets what the provider sells or runs.

status.description: Gets how far the research verified the provider.

statusDate.description: Gets the date the status was established.

ompProviderId.description: Gets the id omp knows the provider by, or null when omp has no native provider for it.

apiKeyEnv.description: Gets the name of the environment variable that carries the key, or null. A name, never a value.

takesKey.description: Gets a value indicating whether the provider takes an API key.

signInOnly.description: Gets a value indicating whether the provider signs in through omp and takes no key.

loginCommand.description: Gets the omp command that signs in for a sign-in provider, or null.

routes.description: Gets the ways to reach the provider; the first is the default.

urlVariables.description: Gets the placeholders the base URLs hold.

docsUrl.description: Gets the vendor documentation, or null.

keyPageUrl.description: Gets the page where a key is created, or null.

sourceUrl.description: Gets the page the row was read on.

note.description: Gets a short caveat, or null. An unverified provider always has one.

oneOf.description: Gets the plan terms of a coding plan, or null.

configured.description: Gets whether the service has a key or sign-in for the provider.

ProviderSummary.description:
One provider, aggregator, coding plan or local runtime of the catalogue, with whether the service has a key for it. A summary holds
no key: it names the environment variable that carries one.

providerId.description: Gets the provider that was tested.

reason.description: Gets the reason for a skipped, blocked or unreachable outcome, or null.

ProviderTestStatus.description: The outcome of a provider test. A test never sends a key, so it says only whether something answers at the address.

label.description: Gets the label of the input.

example.description: Gets an example value, or null.

help.description: Gets a short sentence that says where the user finds the value, or null.

ProviderUrlVariableInfo.description: A named placeholder in the base URL of a route.

ProviderVerification.description: How far the research verified a catalogue provider.

sessionId.description: Gets the identifier of the session the run executes in.

createdAt.description: Gets the time the run was accepted.

completedAt.description: Gets the time the run settled, or null while the run is queued or running.

Run.description: One hosted run: a single prompt executed by the hosted harness inside a session. The run carries its status and no output; the output of a settled run is read as a RunOutput.

path.description: Gets the path of the edited file, as the harness reported it.

oldText.description: Gets the file text before the edit, or null when the edit created the file.

newText.description: Gets the file text after the edit.

RunFileChange.description: One file edit a run's harness reported: the path with the text before and after the edit. This is the harness's own before and after text, not a unified diff or a git patch.

status.description: Gets the run lifecycle state at the time of the read.

oneOf.description: Gets the run's transcript, or null while the run is queued or running.

changes.description: Gets the file changes the harness reported, in the order it reported them, or null while the run is queued or running. Empty when the harness reported none.

RunOutput.description: The output of a run. A queued or running run reports its status with no transcript and no changes. A settled run (completed, failed or cancelled) returns its transcript, and the file changes the harness reported while it ran. A harness that reports no file edit yields an empty change list, so the output is the transcript only.

RunStatus.description: Lifecycle states of a hosted run. A run moves from Queued to Running and ends in exactly one of Completed, Failed or Cancelled.

harnessAdapter.description: Gets the harness adapter name (`InMemory` or `Acp`).

sessionStore.description: Gets the session store name (`InMemory` or `Postgres`).

coordinationStore.description: Gets the coordination store name (`InMemory` or `Dragonfly`).

runLeaseSeconds.description: Gets how long a run lease lasts without renewal, in seconds.

runLeaseRenewSeconds.description: Gets how often the owner of a run lease renews it, in seconds.

maxPromptLength.description: Gets the largest accepted prompt, in characters.

maxRequestBodyBytes.description: Gets the largest accepted request body, in bytes.

promptsPerMinute.description: Gets the prompt submissions allowed per minute.

sessionsPerMinute.description: Gets the session creations allowed per minute.

workspaceRequestsPerMinute.description: Gets the workspace and settings reads allowed per minute.

workspaceConfigured.description: Gets a value indicating whether the API has a workspace folder.

includesUserScope.description: Gets a value indicating whether the user directories of the API process home are read.

maxWorkspaceFileBytes.description: Gets the largest file `GET /workspace/file` returns, in bytes.

RuntimeSettingsResponse.description: The answer of `GET /settings/runtime`: the effective limits and options of the API as read-only values. It holds no secret, no connection string and no path.

messages.description: Gets the run's chat messages, starting with the user prompt.

events.description: Gets the run's stream events, starting with the prompt acceptance event.

RunTranscript.description: The part of a session's record that belongs to one run: the messages and the stream events of that run's turn, in the order they were recorded.

name.description: Gets the display name, 1 to 100 characters.

prompt.description: Gets the instructions each run starts with, 1 to 20000 characters.

enabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether triggers start runs. Default false: a new automation is created off.

oneOf.description: Gets where the runs execute. Default: a cloud agent.

allowedTools.description: Gets the tools a run may use: `pull_request_create`, `pull_request_comment`, `pull_request_request_reviewers`. When absent only `pull_request_create` is allowed.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Gets how many runs may be active at once, 1 to 4. Default 1.

maxRunsPerHour.description: Gets how many runs may start in any rolling hour, 1 to 60. Default 12.

timeZone.description: Gets the IANA time zone cron triggers are evaluated in. Default `UTC`.

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Gets the longest a run may last, in minutes, 1 to 360. Default 30.

SaveAutomationRequest.description: The body of `POST /automations` and `PUT /automations/{id}`. A PUT replaces the whole definition.

ownerId.description: Gets the owner identifier: the subject of the bearer token that created the session.

sandboxId.description: Gets the sandbox identifier, or null when the session runs without a sandbox.

Session.description: An agent session: ordered messages plus the append-only stream-event log.

ownerId.description: Gets the owner identifier: the subject of the bearer token that created the session.

updatedAt.description: Gets the last-update timestamp of the stored session.

sandboxId.description: Gets the sandbox identifier, or null when the session runs without a sandbox.

kind.description: Gets what the session is. Sessions started through this API are CatalogSessionKind.Agent.

rowStatus.description: Gets the status the rail shows for the session.

group.description: Gets the rail group of the session.

lastActivityAt.description: Gets the time of the last activity: the later of the session update and its last logged event.

graphId.description: Gets the Graph identifier of the session's plan, or null when no stage source reported one.

closed.description: Gets a value indicating whether the operator closed the session.

workspaceLabel.description: Gets the name of the folder the session works in, or null when the API has no workspace. It is never a full path.

SessionCatalogEntry.description:
One row of `GET /sessions`: every field of the stored Session under its existing name, plus the catalog fields the web
rail and board need. The catalog fields are additive, so a client that reads the list as sessions keeps working. SessionStatus SessionCatalogEntry.Status is the
stored session status; the richer rail status is CatalogRowStatus SessionCatalogEntry.RowStatus.

path.description: Gets the path of the edited file, as the harness reported it.

kind.description: Gets whether the edits created the file or changed it.

status.description: Gets the review state of the change as it stands.

oldText.description: Gets the file text before the first edit, or null when the edits created the file.

newText.description: Gets the file text after the latest edit.

SessionChange.description: One file the session's runs edited: the net change from the text before the first edit to the text after the latest one.

workspaceAvailable.description: Gets a value indicating whether the API has a workspace folder to apply a decision in. When false, a decision is recorded only.

changes.description: Gets the changes, in the order of their first edit.

name.description: Gets the command name without the leading slash.

description.description: Gets what the command does, as the engine words it, or null.

inputHint.description: Gets the hint for the argument text that follows the command, or null when it takes no input.

SessionCommand.description: One slash command the engine advertises for a session. The engine runs it when a prompt that starts with its name is sent.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether the engine advertised commands for the session. When false, IReadOnlyList<SessionCommand> SessionCommandsResponse.Commands is empty and string? SessionCommandsResponse.Reason says why.

live.description: Gets a value indicating whether the commands come from a live engine session or from the last list an earlier run advertised.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the commands are unavailable or not live, or null.

commands.description: Gets the commands, in the engine's order.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether the engine reported options for the session. When false, IReadOnlyList<ConfigOption> SessionConfigOptionsResponse.Options is empty and string? SessionConfigOptionsResponse.Reason says why.

live.description: Gets a value indicating whether the options come from a live engine session. False means they are the last options an earlier run reported, and a change is refused until a run is live.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the options are unavailable or not live, or null.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether a task-context source answered. When false, TaskContext? SessionContextResponse.Context is null and string? SessionContextResponse.Reason says why.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the context is unavailable, or null when it is available.

oneOf.description: Gets the task context, or null when it is unavailable.

SessionContextResponse.description: The answer of `GET /sessions/{id}/context`: the task context of the session.

closed.description: Gets a value indicating whether the session is closed after the operation.

rowStatus.description: Gets the status the rail shows for the session after the operation.

group.description: Gets the rail group of the session after the operation.

SessionLifecycleResponse.description: The answer of `POST /sessions/{id}/close`, `reopen` and `resume`: the session's row after the operation.

available.description: Gets a value indicating whether plugin stages (planner, orchestrator, substrate, workflow engine) can be observed. When false, IReadOnlyList<StageEvent> SessionStagesResponse.Stages holds the engine stage and one StageStatus.Unavailable stage for each plugin source, and string? SessionStagesResponse.Reason says why.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why plugin stages are unavailable, or null when they are available.

stages.description: Gets the stages: the latest event for each source and stage, in pipeline order.

SessionStagesResponse.description: The answer of `GET /sessions/{id}/stages`: the latest event of every stage of the session.

SessionStatus.description: Lifecycle states of an agent session.

enabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether triggers start runs.

value.description: Gets the value to select. Required; one of the option's string ConfigOptionValue.Value entries.

apiKey.description: Gets the API key. Required, no whitespace, within 512 characters.

planRuleAccepted.description: Gets a value indicating whether the user confirmed that they read the vendor's rule text. Required for a coding plan provider.

SetCredentialRequest.description: The body of `PUT /providers/{id}/credential`. The key is write-only: no response, log or problem repeats it.

licence.description: Gets the SPDX identifier of the licence.

licenceUrl.description: Gets the address of the licence text.

sourceUrl.description: Gets the address of the source repository.

revision.description: Gets the source revision this build was made from, or `unknown` when the build did not record one.

version.description: Gets the assembly version of the service.

SourceInfo.description:
The answer of the anonymous `GET /source`: where the corresponding source of this running service is, as the AGPL-3.0 section 13
source offer requires.

sessionId.description: Gets the identifier of the session the stage belongs to.

source.description: Gets the component that produced the event.

stageId.description: Gets the stage identifier. It is stable within one session and source, so a later event updates the same row.

title.description: Gets the short title of the stage, for display.

status.description: Gets the state of the stage.

timestamp.description: Gets the time the observation was made.

detail.description: Gets a short plain-text explanation, or null when the title says everything. For a degraded or failed stage it names the cause.

parentStageId.description: Gets the identifier of the parent stage within the same source, or null for a top-level stage. A subagent is a child of the orchestrator stage.

graphId.description: Gets the Graph identifier the planner minted for the prompt, or null when no plan exists.

StageEvent.description:
One observation about a stage of the agent loop. Producers emit events as plugins make progress; consumers fold them into a
timeline keyed by string StageEvent.SessionId, StageSource StageEvent.Source and string StageEvent.StageId. A later event for the same key
replaces the earlier one. The event carries plain text only: consumers never interpret any field as markup.

StageSource.description:
The component of the agent loop that produced a StageEvent. The order of the members is the pipeline order:
the planner runs first, the orchestrator second, and the substrate and the workflow engine run alongside them.

StageStatus.description:
The state of one stage of the agent loop. StageStatus.Degraded and StageStatus.Unavailable exist so that a failing or
missing plugin shows as a visible, explained state instead of an exception.

SteerDelivery.description: What the channel did with an accepted steering message. The API never claims more than the engine or the store proved.

text.description: Gets the steering text. Required, not blank, within the configured prompt length.

oneOf.description: Gets how the message reaches the run. Required.

delivery.description: Gets what the channel did with the message.

reason.description: Gets a plain sentence that says why the message failed or was held, or null otherwise. It never repeats the message text.

StreamEvent.description:
A single sequence-numbered event in a session's append-only log.
The SSE transport maps long StreamEvent.Seq to the `id:` field.

StreamEventPayload.description:
Base record for every stream-event payload. Deserialization never throws on
unknown or missing `kind` discriminators: they degrade to
UnknownPayload with the raw payload preserved.

taskId.description: Gets the identifier of the task, or null when the session is not bound to a task.

kanbanStatus.description: Gets the Kanban status of the task as text, or null when unknown.

graphId.description: Gets the Graph identifier the task is registered under, or null.

oneOf.description: Gets the workflow phase of the task, or null when it could not be read.

sharedMemory.description: Gets the shared memory entries that apply to the session.

lessons.description: Gets the lessons from earlier work that apply to the session.

warnings.description: Gets plain-text warnings, one for each part of the context that could not be read.

TaskContext.description:
The context of the task a session works on: its Kanban status, the workflow phase, and what the substrate shares with the
session. Every part is optional. A part that cannot be read is absent and the reason is listed in IReadOnlyList<string> TaskContext.Warnings.

trigger.description: Gets what starts the automation, in words.

enabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether the automation is enabled.

maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Gets the longest a single run may last, in seconds.

oneOf.description: Gets the latest run attempt, or null when there is none.
Gets the pause a guard placed on the automation, or null.

WorkspaceEntryKind.description: The kind of an entry of a workspace folder listing.

path.description: Gets the file as a workspace-relative path with `/` separators.

size.description: Gets the size of the file in bytes.

content.description: Gets the UTF-8 text of the file.

WorkspaceFileResponse.description: The answer of `GET /workspace/file`: the text of one file.

file.description: Gets the file the problem is in.

location.description: Gets a JSON path such as `$.hooks.preToolUse[0].command`, or `$`.

message.description: Gets what is wrong. It holds no absolute server path.

WorkspaceHookDiagnosticInfo.description: One problem found while loading a hook file.

pluginId.description: Gets the id the Hooks page groups the hook under.

scope.description: Gets the scope of the file the hook came from, for example `project` or `user`.

eventName.description: Gets the event name the hook runs on.

isOmpEvent.description: Gets a value indicating whether the event is an omp extension event.

type.description: Gets how the hook decides: `command` or `prompt`.

command.description: Gets the command line of a command hook, or null.

args.description: Gets the argument list of a command hook that has one, or null.

matcher.description: Gets the matcher text, or null.

matcherProblem.description: Gets why the matcher is invalid, or null.

description.description: Gets the free-text description, or null.

enabled.description: Gets a value indicating whether the file leaves the hook on.

failClosed.description: Gets a value indicating whether a failure of the hook blocks the action.

blocking.description: Gets a value indicating whether the hook guards an action.

preConsented.description: Gets a value indicating whether the hook needs no consent because a tamper-resistant managed file declares it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Gets the hook timeout in seconds.

workingDirectory.description: Gets the directory the hook would run in, relative to the workspace folder or `~/` relative.

sourceFile.description: Gets the file the hook came from, relative to the workspace folder or `~/` relative.

WorkspaceHookInfo.description: One hook of the effective hook set. Nothing here starts the hook.

scope.description: Gets the scope of the file.

file.description: Gets the file, relative to the workspace folder or `~/` relative.

format.description: Gets how the file is read.

priority.description: Gets the position of the file in merge order; lower runs first.

WorkspaceHookSourceInfo.description: One hook configuration file that was found.

folderLabel.description: Gets the name of the workspace folder (the last path segment only), or null when the API has no workspace folder.

WorkspaceInfo.description: The answer of `GET /workspace`: what the top bar of the web head shows.

displayName.description: Gets the name shown to the user.

role.description: Gets the plugin's role in a short phrase.

version.description: Gets the plugin version, or null when it is not known.

found.description: Gets a value indicating whether the plugin was found and healthy.

detail.description: Gets a line of detail, or null. It holds no path and no credential.

WorkspacePluginInfo.description: One plugin of the workspace plugin inventory.

name.description: Gets the entry name, without its folder.

kind.description: Gets whether the entry is a file or a folder.

size.description: Gets the size of a file in bytes, or null for a folder.

WorkspaceTreeEntry.description: One entry of a workspace folder listing.

path.description: Gets the folder as a workspace-relative path with `/` separators; empty for the workspace folder itself.

entries.description: Gets the entries in ordinal name order.

truncated.description: Gets a value indicating whether the folder holds more entries than the listing returns.

WorkspaceTreeResponse.description: The answer of `GET /workspace/tree`: the entries of one folder. Secret files and links that leave the workspace are not listed.
